_notes: Gottlieb System 80 (early, 256-byte NVRAM). Single 'Highest Score' stored as 7 reverse-order digits (least-significant first), one BCD digit per byte (low nibble), starting at NVRAM file offset 0x47 (absolute 0x1847). Reverse-engineered and verified against the reference high scores. The shared system80 'generic' map read the wrong region for these titles.
